51145581.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal avi-tagged BRM ATPase-SnAC domain (unknown origin) in absence of ADP by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface-Plasmon-: SPR experiments were performed using a Biacore T100 instrument at 10 °C. Approximately 2000 SPR response units (RU) of N-terminal Avi-tagged BRM ATPase-SnAC were captured onto a Biacore streptavidin (SA)-chip sensor surface in assay buffer containing 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.5), 1 mM MgCl2, 200 mM KCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.005% Tween 20, and 2% DMSO, with the addition of 50 μM ADP depending on the experimental format. Flow cell 1 was left blank as a reference. Compound 1 was injected for 60 s at a flow rate of 100 μL/min with a 120 s dissociation. All data were solvent-corrected and double-referenced using a blank injected immediately prior to the compound-dose response. The data were analyzed using Biacore T100 evaluation software and fit to a simple 1:1 binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 1B caption: SPR dose–response obtained by injection of 2 over N-terminal Avi-tagged BRM ATPase–SnAC immobilized on an SA chip with (top panel) and without (bottom panel) 500 μM ADP. Double-referenced data (colored traces) were fit with a 1:1 binding model (black traces).
original_paragraph.Figure 1B data: The top panel shows sensorgrams for injections of compound 2 at concentrations of 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10, and 30 μM in the presence of 500 μM ADP. The bottom panel shows sensorgrams for the same concentrations in the absence of ADP. The x-axis represents time in seconds, ranging from -40 to 140 s. The y-axis represents response in RU, ranging from 0 to 8. The sensorgrams show a clear dose-dependent response, with higher concentrations leading to higher response levels. The dissociation phase is visible after the injection period (after 60 s).
original_paragraph.Figure 1B text in caption: The top panel shows the baseline-corrected data obtained at 25 °C for injections of inhibitor 2 (200 μM) into the sample cell containing BRM ATPase–SnAC (18.7 μM). In the middle are the calculated enthalpies after subtraction of the reference heat of dilution as determined by the later injections. Data were fit to a simple one-binding-site model to give a K_D value of 0.28 μM. On the bottom is a plot of ΔG, ΔH, –TΔS.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.5), 1 mM MgCl2, 200 mM KCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.005% Tween 20, 2% DMSO, with or without 50 μM ADP

data_analysis.reference_description: Flow cell 1 left blank as a reference
